newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norwegian shares flat, thin volume, few impulses.
newsitem.headline: Norwegian shares flat, thin volume, few impulses.

text.p: The Norwegian stock market paused on Monday with share prices largerly unchanged in lacklustre trade.
Oslo's Total share index closed 0.09 percent higher at 1,270.09 points but short of last week's life peak of 1,276.60.
Turnover was thin at 572 million crowns. Dealers complained the day was slow with few impulses to trade on.

"The index has risen perhaps a bit too quickly in the recent past on the back of the strong dollar," a dealer said. "We expect more liquidity in the market this autumn with additional money flowing into mutual funds."

Ocean Rig was the second most traded share for the second consecutive session with 57.3 million crowns worth of stock changing hands. It finished 7.59 percent higher at 17.10 crowns and has now soared more than 14 percent since Friday.
A dealer said the share was up on expectations of a new contract for the tiny offshore rig company.
Storebrand, Norway's largest insurance group, was the most traded share at 74 million crowns. It fell 0.4 percent to 48.80 crowns.
